layers.message: chore(standards): start usage guide documentation cycle

graderOnly: Active Work.Id is guide-20261004T120000Z-1a2b3c4d and CompletionPolicy is NONE; the cycle is a first DOCUMENTATION cycle started from a standalone Documenter request.
The project has no documentation at all: no README, no docs/ folder, no CHANGELOG; package.json has only a one-line description.
bin/logtally.js runs src/cli.js. Usage: logtally <file> [--format text|json] [--output <path>]; -f and -o are short aliases. --format defaults to text; any other value is a usage error.
--output writes the report to the given path (relative to the working directory) instead of stdout, silently overwriting an existing file; nothing is printed to stdout then.

Exit codes: 0 success; 2 usage error (unknown option, unsupported or missing --format value, missing --output path, missing or extra file argument), printed as 'logtally: <message>' plus the usage line on stderr; 1 when the input cannot be read or the output cannot be written ('logtally: cannot read|write <path>: <code>').

Log lines are recognized as '<token> <LEVEL> ...' with LEVEL one of ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG (uppercase only); blank lines are ignored; other nonblank lines are counted in total and as skipped. Text output lists the four levels, total, and a skipped line only when nonzero; JSON output is {total, counts, skipped}. There is no stdin input.
Established checks in package.json: 'test' (node --test with three explicit files) and 'check' (node --check on bin and src files). Both pass.
No development plan, verification report, or implementation review exists for the cycle, and none should be created.
